text: てきとうに　じかんが　たったら　また　きなさい

structure.jp: てきとうに　じかんが　たったら
structure.en: when a suitable amount of time has passed

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that thing has happened. じかんが　たったら = 'when time has passed'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい on a verb is a gentle order, the kind an older person gives a younger one. きなさい = 'come'.
